winner.text: Add the screened request-context feature family to the additive user/video-ID scorer.
winner.rationale: Training-only temporal screening found request_context (tab, hour, weekday) was the sole positively recommended feature group: +0.00221 primary lift, full coverage, and positive lift on all four screened dates. The official experiment should isolate this family without changing model or loss. Downside risks: the lift is smaller than its daily primary standard deviation (0.00580), context can be temporally nonstationary, and the result may improve broad ordering without placing positives in the top five.
winner.exact_ablation: Relative to seed 0, append train-fitted categorical encodings for tab, hour, and weekday as additive feature weights; retain the seed optimizer, BCE loss, ID features, split, and early stopping unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: Increase by approximately 0.001 to 0.004 if context resolves within-user candidate differences; require a non-negative observed movement.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Increase by approximately 0.000 to 0.003, but it may be flat because the screening evidence reports primary rather than a demonstrated top-five effect.

selection_rationale: c01 is the strongest scarce-experiment choice because it is the only proposal supported by completed training-only temporal evidence: the request-context family produced a +0.00221 primary lift, had full coverage, and improved on all four screened dates. It preserves the proven seed architecture and objective, has low leakage and runtime risk, and offers a reliable, clean ablation. Although the lift is modest relative to daily variation and nDCG@5 benefit is not directly established, its measured evidence, expected gain, confidence, and the Consultant's rank-1 utility assessment outweigh the higher-upside but substantially less validated interaction and loss alternatives.
